alerts.text_en: Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund: zero dissolved oxygen recorded 4 times (Ganesh 2023 after, Durga 2023 pre, Durga 2023 during, Ganesh 2025 during).
Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund: no Durga 2025 table in the report. Missing data is not counted as within the limit; test before, during and after visarjan.
Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund: DO was below 5 mg/l in 11 of 13 readings.
Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund: BOD was above 3 mg/l in all 13 readings.
Malikhedi kund: no Durga 2025 table in the report. Missing data is not counted as within the limit; test before, during and after visarjan.
Malikhedi kund: DO was below 5 mg/l in 9 of 13 readings.
Khatlapura ghat: pH outside the 6.5–8.5 range 1 time (6.49 in Ganesh 2024 during).
Kamla Park kund (Ganesh tables): BOD was above 3 mg/l in all 9 readings.
Rani Kamlapati ghat, Lower Lake (Durga tables): BOD was above 3 mg/l in all 9 readings.
Prempura ghat: pH outside the 6.5–8.5 range 2 times (8.53 in Ganesh 2023 during, 8.55 in Ganesh 2024 during).
Hathaikheda dam / kund: pH outside the 6.5–8.5 range 3 times (8.92 in Ganesh 2023 during, 9.2 in Durga 2024 pre, 8.71 in Ganesh 2025 during).
Hathaikheda dam / kund, Ganesh 2024 after: DO 11 mg/l and BOD 22 mg/l in the same sample. Unusual combination, check the report.
Shahpura lake ghat: BOD was above 3 mg/l in all 18 readings.

text_params.site_group: Rani Kamlapati ghat / Kamla Park kund

alerts.text_en: The report names this point "Rani Kamlapati, Kamla Park, murti visarjan kund" in Ganesh tables and "Rani Kamlapati visarjan ghat (lower lake)" in Durga tables. These may be two places, so they are shown separately. Combined: 24 of 54 readings outside the limit.

insights.text_en: BOD was already above 3 mg/l before immersion in 32 of 37 pre-immersion readings. The data does not show what caused these readings.
BOD was above 3 mg/l in 100 of 112 readings across all ghats. Even the ghat with the lowest share (Prempura ghat) was above the limit in 9 of 15. BOD alone does not separate the ghats; DO does.
Lowest dissolved oxygen: Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund (11 of 13 DO readings below 5 mg/l) and Malikhedi kund (9 of 13 DO readings below 5 mg/l).
Across pH, DO and BOD, Durga readings were outside the limit 76 of 166 times (46%) and Ganesh readings 72 of 177 times (41%). The two festivals fall in different seasons.
Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund and Malikhedi kund, the ghats with the lowest DO, have no Durga 2025 table, so the most recent Durga readings are missing where DO was lowest before.
In Ganesh 2025, Bairagarh (Sant Hirdaram) kund and Malikhedi kund have only "during" readings; pre and after were not sampled (the report suggests temporary kunds).
DO below 5 mg/l by phase: pre 12 of 38, during 18 of 40, after 12 of 38.

limitations: Only pH, DO and BOD have CPCB class B limits. Total coliform (also a class B limit) was not tested, so no site can be said to meet class B.
Pre-immersion readings already exceed limits often, so the data does not show that immersion caused them.
Units are not printed in the reports; standard units are assumed (mg/l for DO and BOD).
One grab sample per phase; no replicates, sampling times or temperatures are reported.
Bairagarh and Malikhedi have no Durga 2025 table, and only "during" readings for Ganesh 2025.
Rani Kamlapati ghat (Durga tables) and Kamla Park kund (Ganesh tables) may be two places; they are shown separately.
2025 metal values of 0.03 / 0.031 repeat across sites and may be detection limits. Metals are not used for ranking.
Latest data is 2025; nothing here predicts conditions on 20 October 2026.
Missing readings (not sampled, or no table in the report) are never counted as within the limit and are left out of the counts.
A value exactly at a limit (DO = 5.0, BOD = 3.0) is counted as within the limit.
The brief is in English only; a Hindi brief has not been produced.
